name: TikTok Display API
summary: The TikTok Display API: profile and videos of the TikTok user who authorized your app.

token.description: A TikTok user access token from the Login Kit OAuth flow with scopes user.info.basic and video.list (TikTok for Developers > your app)

notes: Own-account data only: every call reads the user who authorized the token, never other creators.
A user access token lives 2 hours; its refresh token lives 180 days and is replaced at each refresh. Refresh outside this catalog and set the new token.
Fields are opt-in: name the ones you want in the fields query parameter; each needs its scope.

endpoints.name: Get the authorized user's profile
endpoints.summary: Open id, display name, avatar and (with extra scopes) bio, username and counts of the TikTok user who authorized the token.

fields.description: Comma-separated fields. user.info.basic: open_id, union_id, avatar_url, avatar_url_100, avatar_large_url, display_name. user.info.profile: bio_description, profile_deep_link, is_verified, username. user.info.stats: follower_count, following_count, likes_count, video_count.

notes: Only fields whose scope the user granted are returned.

endpoints.name: List the authorized user's videos
endpoints.summary: The user's public videos, newest first.

fields.description: Comma-separated video fields, e.g. id, title, cover_image_url.

cursor.description: Unix time in milliseconds; pass the previous response's cursor while has_more is true.

notes: A read over POST. Needs the video.list scope. Only the authorizing user's own videos.

endpoints.name: Get specific videos of the authorized user
endpoints.summary: Details for up to 20 video ids that belong to the user.

fields.description: Comma-separated video fields, e.g. id, title, cover_image_url, share_url, like_count.

notes: A read over POST. Needs the video.list scope. The ids are checked against the authorizing user: use only their own videos.
